original:
Moreover, for every $n\leq 13$ and every
 $b\in\{0,1,2\}^{n}$ with $|b|=n$ , the coefficient
 $c_{b,(1^{n})}(t)$ has no negative terms. Thus degree fourteen is minimal
within this family.

open scoped BigOperators

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux1
    (n d : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin n → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
    (β : Fin n → ℕ) (hβ : ∀ i, β i ≤ d) (hs : ∑ i, β i = d)
    (L : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ) →ₗ[RatFunc ℚ] RatFunc ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ b : Fin n → ℕ, (∑ i, b i) = d →
      L (A b) = if b = β then 1 else 0)
    (hc : x2611_16899_expansion n d P A c) :
    L P = c β := by
  classical
  let γ₀ : Fin n → Fin (d + 1) := fun i => ⟨β i, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hβ i)⟩
  have hval : (fun i => (γ₀ i).val) = β := rfl
  calc
    L P = ∑ γ : Fin n → Fin (d + 1),
        if (∑ i, (γ i).val) = d then
          c (fun i => (γ i).val) * L (A (fun i => (γ i).val)) else 0 := by
      rw [hc, map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro γ _
      split_ifs <;> simp [MvPolynomial.C_mul', map_smul]
    _ = c β := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single γ₀]
      · rw [hval, if_pos hs, hL β hs, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
      · intro γ _ hne
        split_ifs with hsum
        · rw [hL _ hsum, if_neg, mul_zero]
          intro he
          apply hne
          funext i
          exact Fin.ext (congrFun he i)
        · rfl
      · simp

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux2
    (f : RatFunc ℚ) (p : Polynomial ℚ)
    (hf : f = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) p)
    (hp : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 ≤ p.coeff r) :
    f.denom = 1 ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, 0 ≤ f.num.coeff r := by
  subst f
  simpa only [RatFunc.denom_algebraMap, RatFunc.num_algebraMap, true_and] using hp

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux3
    (K A : (Fin 0 → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin 0) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin 0 → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
    (hK : x2611_16899_key_family 0 K)
    (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family 0 RatFunc.X A)
    (hc : x2611_16899_expansion 0 0 (K (fun _ => 1)) A c) :
    c (fun _ => 1) = 1 := by
  classical
  have hK1 : K (fun _ => 1) = 1 := by
    simpa using hK.1 (fun _ => 1) (by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i)
  have hA1 : A (fun _ => 1) = 1 := by
    simpa using hA.1 (fun _ => 1) (by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i)
  have hL : ∀ b : Fin 0 → ℕ, (∑ i, b i) = 0 →
      MvPolynomial.coeff 0 (A b) = if b = (fun _ => 1) then 1 else 0 := by
    intro b _
    have hb : b = (fun _ => 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst b
    simp [hA1]
  have hh := x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux1 0 0 (K (fun _ => 1)) A c
    (fun _ => 1) (by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i) (by simp)
    (MvPolynomial.lcoeff (RatFunc ℚ) 0) hL hc
  simpa [hK1] using hh.symm

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux4
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 1) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (hs : ∑ i, b i = n)
    (K A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin n → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
    (hK : x2611_16899_key_family n K)
    (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family n RatFunc.X A)
    (hc : x2611_16899_expansion n n (K b) A c) :
    (c (fun _ => 1)).denom = 1 ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, 0 ≤ (c (fun _ => 1)).num.coeff r := by
  have he : c (fun _ => 1) = 1 := by
    interval_cases n
    · have hb : b = (fun _ => 1) := by funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
      subst b
      exact x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux3 K A c hK hA hc
    · have hb : b = (fun _ => 1) := by
        funext i
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        simpa [hi] using hs
      subst b
      exact x2611_16899_singleton_coefficient K A c hK hA hc
  apply x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux2 _ 1
  · simpa using he
  · intro r
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_one]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux5
    (τ : RatFunc ℚ)
    (K A : (Fin 2 → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin 2 → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
    (b : Fin 2 → ℕ) (hs : ∑ i, b i = 2)
    (hK : x2611_16899_key_family 2 K)
    (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family 2 τ A)
    (hc : x2611_16899_expansion 2 2 (K b) A c) :
    c (fun _ => 1) = if b 0 = 0 then τ else if b 0 = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  have hant20 : Antitone (![2, 0] : Fin 2 → ℕ) := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num at *
  have hant11 : Antitone (![1, 1] : Fin 2 → ℕ) := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num
  have hswap : (![0, 2] : Fin 2 → ℕ) ∘ Equiv.swap 0 1 = ![2, 0] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  have hK20 : K ![2, 0] = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2 := by
    simpa using hK.1 _ hant20
  have hK11 : K ![1, 1] = MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
    simpa using hK.1 _ hant11
  have hA20 : A ![2, 0] = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2 := by
    simpa using hA.1 _ hant20
  have hA11 : A ![1, 1] = MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 := by
    simpa using hA.1 _ hant11
  have hne : (MvPolynomial.X 0 - MvPolynomial.X 1 :
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (RatFunc ℚ)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [sub_eq_zero, MvPolynomial.X_injective.eq_iff] using
      (show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide)
  have hK02 : K ![0, 2] = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2 +
      MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hne
    rw [hK.2 ![0, 2] 0 1 (by rfl) (by norm_num), hswap, hK20]
    simp
    ring
  have hA02 : A ![0, 2] = MvPolynomial.C (1 - τ) *
      MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hne
    rw [hA.2 ![0, 2] 0 1 (by rfl) (by norm_num), hswap, hA20]
    simp
    ring
  let m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1
  let u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 1 2
  let L : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (RatFunc ℚ) →ₗ[RatFunc ℚ] RatFunc ℚ :=
    MvPolynomial.lcoeff (RatFunc ℚ) m +
      (τ - 1) • MvPolynomial.lcoeff (RatFunc ℚ) u
  have hL20 : L (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2) = 0 := by
    simp [L, m, u, MvPolynomial.coeff_X_pow, Finsupp.ext_iff]
  have hL11 : L (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) = 1 := by
    simp [L, m, u, MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, Finsupp.ext_iff]
  have hL02 : L (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2) = τ - 1 := by
    simp [L, m, u, MvPolynomial.coeff_X_pow, Finsupp.ext_iff]
  have hL (a : Fin 2 → ℕ) (ha : ∑ i, a i = 2) :
      L (A a) = if a = (fun _ => 1) then 1 else 0 := by
    have ha0 : a 0 ≤ 2 := by have hh := ha; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hh; omega
    have hae : a = ![a 0, a 1] := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at ha
    interval_cases h : a 0
    · have h1 : a 1 = 2 := by omega
      rw [hae, h1, hA02]
      simp only [map_add]
      rw [show (MvPolynomial.C (1 - τ) * MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (RatFunc ℚ)) =
          (1 - τ) • (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1) by
            rw [mul_assoc, MvPolynomial.C_mul'], map_smul, hL11, hL02]
      simp [show (![0, 2] : Fin 2 → ℕ) ≠ (fun _ => 1) by
        intro he; have hh := congrFun he 0; norm_num at hh]
    · have h1 : a 1 = 1 := by omega
      rw [hae, h1, hA11, hL11]
      simp [show (![1, 1] : Fin 2 → ℕ) = (fun _ => 1) by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp]
    · have h1 : a 1 = 0 := by omega
      rw [hae, h1, hA20, hL20]
      simp [show (![2, 0] : Fin 2 → ℕ) ≠ (fun _ => 1) by
        intro he; have hh := congrFun he 0; norm_num at hh]
  have hext := x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux1 2 2 (K b) A c
    (fun _ => 1) (by intro i; omega) (by simp) L hL hc
  rw [← hext]
  have hb0 : b 0 ≤ 2 := by have hh := hs; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hh; omega
  have hbe : b = ![b 0, b 1] := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hs
  interval_cases h : b 0
  · have h1 : b 1 = 2 := by omega
    rw [hbe, h1, hK02, map_add, map_add, hL20, hL11, hL02]
    simp
  · have h1 : b 1 = 1 := by omega
    rw [hbe, h1, hK11, hL11]
    simp
  · have h1 : b 1 = 0 := by omega
    rw [hbe, h1, hK20, hL20]
    simp

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux6
    (K A : (Fin 2 → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin 2 → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
    (b : Fin 2 → ℕ) (hs : ∑ i, b i = 2)
    (hK : x2611_16899_key_family 2 K)
    (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family 2 RatFunc.X A)
    (hc : x2611_16899_expansion 2 2 (K b) A c) :
    (c (fun _ => 1)).denom = 1 ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, 0 ≤ (c (fun _ => 1)).num.coeff r := by
  have he := x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux5 RatFunc.X K A c b hs hK hA hc
  by_cases h0 : b 0 = 0
  · rw [if_pos h0] at he
    rw [he]
    constructor
    · exact RatFunc.denom_X
    · intro r
      rw [RatFunc.num_X, Polynomial.coeff_X]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · by_cases h1 : b 0 = 1
    · rw [if_neg h0, if_pos h1] at he
      rw [he]
      constructor
      · exact RatFunc.denom_one
      · intro r
        rw [RatFunc.num_one, Polynomial.coeff_one]
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h1] at he
      rw [he]
      simp

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux7
    (n : ℕ) (τ : RatFunc ℚ)
    (A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family n τ A) :
    let W : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ) := ∏ ij : Fin n × Fin n,
        if ij.1 < ij.2 then
          (MvPolynomial.X ij.2 - MvPolynomial.X ij.1) *
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              MvPolynomial.C (τ ^ k) * MvPolynomial.X ij.1 ^ k *
                MvPolynomial.X ij.2 ^ (n - k)
        else 1
    let m : Fin n →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm
      (fun i => 1 + (n + 1) * i.val)
    ∀ b : Fin n → ℕ, (∑ i, b i) = n →
      MvPolynomial.coeff m (A b * W) = if b = (fun _ => 1) then 1 else 0 := by
  dsimp only
  sorry

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux8
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hn' : n ≤ 13) (b : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ 2) (hs : ∑ i, b i = n)
    (K : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (hK : x2611_16899_key_family n K) :
    let W : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ) := ∏ ij : Fin n × Fin n,
        if ij.1 < ij.2 then
          (MvPolynomial.X ij.2 - MvPolynomial.X ij.1) *
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              MvPolynomial.C (RatFunc.X ^ k) * MvPolynomial.X ij.1 ^ k *
                MvPolynomial.X ij.2 ^ (n - k)
        else 1
    let m : Fin n →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm
      (fun i => 1 + (n + 1) * i.val)
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℚ,
      MvPolynomial.coeff m (K b * W) = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) p ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, 0 ≤ p.coeff r := by
  dsimp only
  sorry

theorem x2611_16899_thm1_minimality
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 13) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ 2)
    (hs : Finset.univ.sum b = n)
    (K A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin n → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
    (hK : x2611_16899_key_family n K)
    (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family n RatFunc.X A)
    (hc : x2611_16899_expansion n n (K b) A c) :
    (c (fun _ => 1)).denom = 1 ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, 0 ≤ (c (fun _ => 1)).num.coeff r := by
  classical
  by_cases hnsmall : n ≤ 1
  · exact x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux4 n hnsmall b hs K A c hK hA hc
  by_cases hn2 : n = 2
  · subst n
    exact x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux6 K A c b hs hK hA hc
  let W : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ) := ∏ ij : Fin n × Fin n,
      if ij.1 < ij.2 then
        (MvPolynomial.X ij.2 - MvPolynomial.X ij.1) *
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            MvPolynomial.C (RatFunc.X ^ k) * MvPolynomial.X ij.1 ^ k *
              MvPolynomial.X ij.2 ^ (n - k)
      else 1
  let m : Fin n →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm
    (fun i => 1 + (n + 1) * i.val)
  let L : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ) →ₗ[RatFunc ℚ] RatFunc ℚ :=
    (MvPolynomial.lcoeff (RatFunc ℚ) m).comp (LinearMap.mulRight (RatFunc ℚ) W)
  have hdual : ∀ a : Fin n → ℕ, (∑ i, a i) = n →
      L (A a) = if a = (fun _ => 1) then 1 else 0 :=
    x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux7 n RatFunc.X A hA
  have hext := x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux1 n n (K b) A c
    (fun _ => 1) (by intro i; omega) (by simp) L hdual hc
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpos⟩ :=
    x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux8 n (by omega) hn b hb hs K hK
  exact x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_aux2 _ p (hext.symm.trans hp) hpos
